root_cause.text: Missing NULL check for `attr_name_kobj` in the `GET_INSTANCE_ID` macro, combined with an off-by-one loop bound (`<=` instead of `<`), allows dereferencing a NULL pointer or accessing beyond array bounds when reading sysfs attributes, leading to a kernel panic.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check (`if (bioscfg_drv.type##_data[i].attr_name_kobj && ...)`) and corrects the loop condition from `<=` to `<` to prevent out-of-bounds access. The CVE description and panic trace (`KASAN: null-ptr-deref in range [0x0000000000000000-0x0000000000000007]` at `min_length_show+0xcf`) confirm the null pointer dereference.
